_note: Placeholder dialogue sequences for internal monologue and random radio chatter. Text uses the pixel font character set: A-Z 0-9 . , ' - : ? ! ( ) / + = %
_characters_note: Who can speak. 'character' on an entry says who speaks its lines (default: you); a line can also be {"who": id, "text": ...}. 'voice' is the Undertale-style blip standing in for voice acting (see UiSounds.add_voice); 'every' is letters per blip. 'portrait' (optional) is a PNG strip of idle | talking | blinking frames; without one, scripts/ui/portraits.gd draws a placeholder.

intro_wake.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
intro_wake.title: WAKING UP
lines: YEAR 2094. DAY 14 OF THE WET-BULB STORM CYCLE.
OUROBOROS SHELTER 03 - PACIFIC NORTHWEST. SEALED TIGHT AGAINST THE HEAT.
THE GRID COLLAPSED WEEKS AGO. IT'S JUST ME AND WHATEVER STILL WORKS IN THIS CABIN.

hint_use_radio.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
hint_use_radio.title: THE DEAD RADIO
lines: IVE CHECKED EVERY CORNER OF THE CABIN. STILL SEALED.
THE HAM RADIO ON THE WORKBENCH IS COMPLETELY DEAD - ITS SPEAKER IS RIPPED OUT.
I NEED TO CHECK THE RADIO AND FIND A WAY TO FIX IT IF I WANT TO HEAR ANYONE OUT THERE.

inspect_radio_broken.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_radio_broken.title: BROKEN HAM RADIO
lines: THE SPEAKER CONE IS GONE. JUST BARE RED AND YELLOW WIRES HANGING OUT.
MAYBE I CAN SALVAGE A WORKING SPEAKER FROM SOMEWHERE ELSE IN THE CABIN.

radio_repaired.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
radio_repaired.title: RADIO ONLINE
lines: THE SPEAKER IS WIRED IN. THE FREQUENCY DISPLAY JUST FLICKERED TO LIFE.
NOW I JUST HAVE TO KEEP AN EAR OUT FOR ANY INCOMING TRANSMISSIONS.

inspect_shutters_open.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_shutters_open.title: THE HEAT
lines: UGH - THE HEAT HITS LIKE AN OVEN DOOR. BETTER NOT LEAVE THE SHUTTERS OPEN TOO LONG.

inspect_speaker.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_speaker.title: PA SPEAKER
lines: THE SHELTER PA SPEAKER. THE STATUS LED STILL BREATHES, EVEN WITH THE LINE DEAD.

inspect_lantern.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_lantern.title: OIL LANTERN
lines: OIL LANTERN. BURNING LOW TO SAVE FUEL.

inspect_instruments.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_instruments.title: WEATHER GAUGES
lines: BAROMETER AND HYGROMETER. THE NEEDLES ARE PEGGED IN THE RED.

inspect_power.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_power.title: POWER STATION
lines: PORTABLE POWER STATION. FOUR CELLS STILL HOLDING A CHARGE.
A SPARE BATTERY IS CLICKED INTO THE FRONT. I CAN TAKE IT.

inspect_filter.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_filter.title: WATER FILTER
lines: GRAVITY WATER FILTER. SLOW DRIP, CLEAN WATER.

inspect_crates.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_crates.title: RATION CRATES
lines: DRY RATION CRATES. ENOUGH TINS FOR ANOTHER FEW WEEKS.

inspect_sandbags.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_sandbags.title: SANDBAGS
lines: SANDBAGS STACKED AGAINST FLASH RUNOFF.

leak_noticed.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
leak_noticed.title: THE LEAK
lines: WATER'S RUNNING IN UNDER THE WINDOW.
ONE OF THE SANDBAGS GOT SHOVED UP ONTO THE PILE. THE HOLE IN THE WALL BEHIND IT IS WIDE OPEN.
I NEED TO PUT THAT BAG BACK BEFORE THE STORM FLOODS THE FLOOR.

sandbag_plugged.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
sandbag_plugged.title: PLUGGED
lines: THERE. BAG'S BACK OVER THE HOLE. THE FLOOR CAN DRY OUT NOW.
SHAME TO WASTE ALL THAT RAIN, THOUGH. THE FILTER'S INTAKE WOULD FIT THROUGH THERE.

filter_hole_open.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
filter_hole_open.title: WATER FILTER
lines: NOT WITH WATER POURING IN UNDER THE WINDOW. THE SANDBAG GOES BACK IN THAT HOLE FIRST.

filter_installed.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
filter_installed.title: WATER FILTER
lines: INTAKE OUT THROUGH THE HOLE, A RUBBER BOOT AND SOME RAGS AROUND IT. THE BAG CAN SIT ON THE PILE.
THE RAIN RUNS IN, DRIPS THROUGH THE CERAMIC CANDLES, AND OUT OF THE TAP INTO THE JUG.
THE TOP BUCKET'S SEALED TO THE INTAKE, THOUGH. IT ONLY DRAINS WITH THE SHUTTERS OPEN TO LET AIR IN.

filter_shutters_shut.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
filter_shutters_shut.title: WATER FILTER
lines: IT JUST GURGLES. NO AIR GETTING IN - THE SHUTTERS HAVE TO BE OPEN FOR IT TO DRAIN.
IF IT'S HOT OUT, THE TANK WILL FEEL IT, THOUGH.

filter_no_rain.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
filter_no_rain.title: WATER FILTER
lines: NOTHING COMING IN. NO RAIN, NO WATER. NO POINT LETTING THE HEAT IN FOR IT TODAY.

filter_running.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
filter_running.title: WATER FILTER
lines: SLOW DRIP, CLEAN WATER. THE JUG UNDER THE TAP IS FILLING.

jug_empty.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
jug_empty.title: WATER JUG
lines: AN EMPTY JUG UNDER THE FILTER'S TAP. NOTHING'S COMING THROUGH WITHOUT WATER GOING IN THE TOP.

jug_filling.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
jug_filling.title: WATER JUG
lines: NOT FULL YET. IT ONLY FILLS WHILE THE FILTER'S RUNNING: SHUTTERS OPEN, RAIN COMING IN.

tank_water_change.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
tank_water_change.title: WATER CHANGE
lines: FRESH WATER IN. IT THINS OUT THE CO2 AND BRINGS SOME OXYGEN WITH IT.
ONE JUG WON'T FIX IT. BACK UNDER THE TAP IT GOES.

bed_leaking.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
bed_leaking.title: NOT YET
lines: I CAN'T SLEEP WITH THE STORM RUNNING IN UNDER THE WINDOW. THAT SANDBAG GOES BACK FIRST.

inspect_flashlight.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_flashlight.title: FLASHLIGHT
lines: HEAVY DUTY FLASHLIGHT CHARGING ON THE POWER BANK.

inspect_tank.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_tank.title: THE REEF
lines: MY LITTLE REEF. NEARLY EVERY CORAL IN THERE HAS GONE BONE WHITE.
WHEN THE WATER STAYS TOO WARM, CORALS SPIT OUT THE ALGAE THAT FEED AND COLOUR THEM. THAT'S BLEACHING.
THEY CAN RECOVER IF THE WATER COOLS IN TIME. THE CHILLER DIED THREE DAYS AGO.
THE FISH ARE STILL GOING. THEY KEEP GULPING AT THE SURFACE, THOUGH.

inspect_tank_gauges.speaker: INTERNAL MONOLOGUE
inspect_tank_gauges.title: TANK READINGS
lines: WATER TEMP: 31.4 C. MOST REEF CORALS START TO BLEACH AROUND 30.
PH: 7.74. THE OCEANS WERE ABOUT 8.2 BEFORE WE STARTED BURNING COAL. CO2 MAKES SEAWATER MORE ACIDIC.
ACIDIC WATER EATS AT SHELLS AND SKELETONS. THE CORALS CAN'T REBUILD FAST ENOUGH.
OXYGEN: 3.6 MG/L. WARMER WATER HOLDS LESS OF IT. BELOW 2, NOTHING IN THERE MAKES IT.

radio_chatter.speaker: RADIO // COASTAL AQUARIUM
radio_chatter.title: BEACON K6-AQUA: COOLING PUMPS
lines: KZZT... AUTOMATED BEACON K6-AQUA... COASTAL AQUARIUM...
COOLING PUMPS FAILING IN KELP FOREST TANK 2. SEA SURFACE TEMP AT 34C.
ANY SHELTER READING THIS: OUR MARINE BIOLOGISTS ARE STILL INSIDE... KZZT...

lines.text: A SIGNAL... SOMEONE IS STILL OUT THERE.

radio_chatter.speaker: RADIO // COASTAL AQUARIUM
radio_chatter.title: AQUARIUM DISPATCH: DEEP REEF
lines: KZZT... AQUARIUM DISPATCH... WE REROUTED SOLAR POWER TO THE DEEP REEF TANKS.
THE OTTERS AND KELP SPORES ARE SAFE IN THE SUB-BASEMENT CHILLER FOR NOW... KZZT...

radio_chatter.speaker: RADIO // COASTAL AQUARIUM
radio_chatter.title: K6-AQUA: HOURLY BROADCAST
lines: KZZT... THIS IS K6-AQUA... IF YOUR TRANSMITTER IS BROKEN, JUST KEEP LISTENING.
WE BROADCAST ON THE HOUR. HOLD ON UP THERE IN THE HIGHLANDS... KZZT...

radio_chatter.speaker: RADIO // COASTAL AQUARIUM
radio_chatter.title: TELEMETRY: CHILLER LOOP B
lines: KZZT... AQUARIUM TELEMETRY: CHILLER LOOP B AT 62% CAPACITY... KZZT...

radio_chatter.speaker: RADIO // COASTAL AQUARIUM
radio_chatter.title: TELEMETRY: TIDE GAUGE
lines: KZZT... TIDE GAUGE +2.4M... SEA WALL HOLDING... KZZT...
